chunks: We could turn it, if We pleased, into straw; then you would rue the day,

key_terms.تَفَکَّهُونَ: you would rue or lament bitterly
key_terms.حُطَاماً: straw or dried plant matter, symbolizing something insignificant or easily destroyed

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'straw' in Surah Al-Waqi'ah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine contingency of the Quran's preservation, reminding believers that its current status as a clear guide is a specific act of God's will rather than an inherent necessity. It serves as a warning against complacency, illustrating that if God had willed, the text could have been reduced to 'straw' (hutam), leaving humanity in a state of idle regret and confusion on the Day of Judgment.
